results.title: Feature Request: Certificate Expiry Only Monitor with SNI and Target IP Support · Issue #7500 · louislam/uptime-kuma · GitHub
results.content:
### 🔖 Feature description

Uptime Kuma already supports certificate expiry notifications for HTTP(S) monitors. However, this is currently tied to monitoring the service/website itself.

It would be very useful to have a dedicated monitor type or option that checks only the TLS/SSL certificate expiration of a given host, without treating the HTTP service availability, HTTP status code, response body, keyword checks, redirects, or general uptime of the website as the main monitoring target. [...] Add SSL Certificate checks for General TCP ports #1079 — This requests SSL certificate checks for general TCP ports. It is related because it expands certificate monitoring beyond classic HTTPS checks, but my request focuses on HTTP(S)/TLS certificate expiry without considering the HTTP service status as the primary check. [...] Connect to the configured hostname or target IP and port using TLS.
 Allow setting the SNI hostname separately from the connection target.
 Support checking virtual hosts on a specific IP address.
 Read the presented certificate for the configured SNI hostname.
 Check the certificate expiration date.
 Trigger warnings/notifications based only on the configured certificate expiry thresholds.
 Optionally show the remaining days until expiration.

## Uptime Kuma is Missing Authorization Checks on Ping Badge Endpoint, Leaks Ping times of monitors without needing to be on a status page

Moderate severity   GitHub Reviewed   Published Mar 11, 2026 in  louislam/uptime-kuma  • Updated Mar 13, 2026

## Package

uptime-kuma  (npm)

## Affected versions

>= 2.0.0, <= 2.1.3

## Patched versions

2.2.0

## Description

## Summary [...] ## PoC

1. Install Uptime Kuma (tested on latest v2 stable via Docker)
2. Create an HTTP(s) monitor (e.g., monitoring )
3. Do NOT add the monitor to any public status page or group
4. Wait for heartbeats to accumulate (~5 minutes)
5. Query unauthenticated:

```
"Avg. Ping (24h): 10ms" " "
```

## Impact

An unauthenticated attacker can:

 Enumerate private monitor IDs
 Extract average response time data for private monitors
 Infer existence and reachability of internal monitored services
